dedupe_keys.name: usgs mineral facilities of latin america and the caribbean

description: This USGS data release lists facilities of the mineral industries of Latin America and the Caribbean: mines, mineral processing plants including refineries and smelters, oil and gas field locations and petroleum refineries. For each facility it gives the mineral commodity and the specific form produced, facility name, operator and owners, annual production capacity, operational status, geographic coordinates and location accuracy. The records derive from the country chapters of the USGS Minerals Yearbook volume III (International Reports), prepared by the Global Minerals Analysis section of the National Minerals Information Center. The release was published on 24 October 2016 on ScienceBase as a CSV file (about 430 KB) with FGDC metadata, free to download; a licence is not stated on the page read. It was compiled for the Inter-American Development Bank and is documented in USGS Open-File Report 2017-1079, which also offers a geodatabase and map. Caveats: capacities are nominal yearbook values, the information date is 2014, and the list is not updated. For simulation it gives the locations and capacities of mines, smelters and refineries in a region that supplies copper, lithium and iron ore, for exposure analysis and for supply chain disruption models of critical minerals. Related catalogue records include the USGS Mineral Resources Data System, the USGS Mineral Commodity Summaries and the Global Iron Ore Mines Tracker.
